rules.inject: Rules work: invoke skill `ai-kit:create-rules` (Codex: `create-rules`). It asks the scope (plugin-wide `~/.ai-kit/AGENTS.md`, workspace, repository, subfolder) and hands workspace/repo setup to `ai-kit:setup-rules`, which owns `.ai-kit/workspace.json`, AGENTS.md and the CLAUDE.md import.

Creating a PR/MR: invoke skill `ai-kit:pr-submit` from inside the repo on the feature branch; host and CLI come from `.ai-kit/workspace.json` (vcs). PR body via `ai-kit:solution-doc`. Do not hand-roll push + API calls.
Brainstorming acceptance criteria or an approach: invoke skill `ai-kit:brainstormer` (question rounds with recommendations, decisions logged as DEC-nnn in the work folder).

rules.match: \b(call chain|what calls|who calls|sequence diagram|request flow|execution flow|data flow|code flow|design diagram)\b|\b(draw|redraw|create|update|render|give me)\b.{0,40}\bdiag?ram\b
rules.inject: Flow/interaction explanation: invoke skill `ai-kit:less-words-more-arrows` to render it as a diagram, not prose only.
Ticket work: use skill `ai-kit:ticket` (tracker from `.ai-kit/workspace.json`); full delivery from a ticket: `ai-kit:story`.
